subject: Greenlight handoff + start-date guardrails for Q3 deployment
messages:
From: Hannah Riley <h.riley@orbitalretail.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Weber <m.weber@orbitalretail.com>, LegalOps <legal@orbitalretail.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final decision timeline + start-date ask

Marcus — thanks for the detailed demo last week. We’re at the final stages internally and need to lock the mutual action plan and the operational start window. Two asks from my side: 

1) Procurement/legal want a clear signing window and the final term sheet/SOW to route to approvals (their review takes ~3 business days once they see a final doc).
2) Our ops team needs a pinned start date for onboarding so they can block resources (tentative target: week of July 5).

I’ve attached our internal decision calendar (Orbital_decision_calendar.xlsx). Can Redwood confirm: if we receive a final term sheet + SOW by 5/27, can your team issue DocuSign the same day and support a 5-business-day signature window? Also, please confirm any blocker clauses (data residency, SLA escalation) we should expect in the SOW.

If easier, let’s set a 30-minute sync Thursday (5/20) to run through final items.

—Hannah
Hannah Riley
VP, Platform Partnerships | Orbital Retail
attachments: Orbital_decision_calendar.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Riley <h.riley@orbitalretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final decision timeline + start-date ask

Hannah — appreciate the clear calendar. Looping in Marissa (onboarding), Karthik (sales ops) and Ben (legal) so we can validate timelines. Quick responses below and a proposed playbook: 

- Doc turnaround: Redwood legal will aim to publish a final term sheet + SOW by EOD 5/26 if there are no material redlines. If Orbital provides redlines before EOD 5/23 we can usually fold them in.
- DocuSign cadence: we can send the envelope same day we finalize documents; recommend a 5 business-day signature window but flexible to shorten to 3 days if legal confirms.
- Start date contingency: we can target July 5, but Marissa notes an earlier start (July 1) is possible if all signatures complete by 6/30 and pre-kickoff items are closed.

Proposed immediate actions (short checklist):
1) Redwood legal to publish draft term sheet + SOW (ben_carter).
2) Orbital to return any redlines by 5/23 EOD (h.riley).
3) Internal go/no-go sync: Wed 5/26 10:00am PT — decision owners: Marissa (onboarding), Ben (legal), Karthik (ops), Marcus (sales).
4) If green, send DocuSign 5/27 and allow 5 business days for signatures.

Marissa — can you confirm resource availability for a July 1 vs July 5 kickoff and the prerequisites you need from Orbital?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Final decision timeline + start-date ask

Marcus — I’ll take point on the term sheet + SOW.

Quick notes: 
- I can deliver a redline-ready term sheet by EOD Monday (5/24) if Orbital doesn’t materially change the commercial terms. SOW v2 is attached (Redwood_SOW_v2.docx) — that contains the onboarding milestones and the standard data residency language.
- Signature window: 5 business days is fine; suggest we put an explicit fallback clause that allows automatic activation of a short-term sandbox if signatures slip beyond the window (keeps momentum).
- Flag: Orbital’s legal should confirm SOC2 evidence + retention requirements now; if they demand alternate retention or regional-only hosting, that will impact schedules and require private deployment planning.

Attaching: TermSheet_template_redline_stub.pdf (will update Monday).

—Ben

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final decision timeline + start-date ask

Thanks Marcus/Hannah — from an onboarding and delivery perspective:

- Resource booking: To meet a 2027-07-01 start we need signed agreement + completed pre-kick checklist by 2027-06-30. Key pre-kick items: access to sample data, contact list for integrations, and completion of security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence).
- Milestones (high-level): Week 0 (kickoff), Week 1 (data ingestion test), Week 3 (first eval), Week 6 (production cutover readiness). We can compress by ~1 week with extra engineering overlap but risk higher operations friction.
- Proposal: Keep July 1 as preferred start; agree to July 5 only if signatures run right up to timeline and Orbital asks for extra soak time.

Action: Hannah — can your team confirm availability for a kickoff week that starts either 7/1 or 7/5 and share the security contact for SOC2 verification?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Weber <m.weber@orbitalretail.com>

Marcus/Team — thanks for the clarity. A few procurement constraints from our side:

- LegalOps requests the final term sheet and SOW no later than 5/27 so they can complete routing by 5/31. Their preferred signature window is 5/27–5/31.
- SOC2: they need SOC2 Type II report and a high-level retention summary. If Redwood confirms standard retention (30 days for logs, 12 months for audit traces) and SOC2 link, LegalOps will prioritize review.
- We can accelerate to 2027-07-01 start if DocuSign completes by 6/24 (earlier signature is better for our internal project schedule).

I’ve attached our procurement checklist (Orbital_procurement_checklist.pdf) showing approver names and SLAs.

—Markus

Subject: Re: Final decision timeline + start-date ask (Final decision playbook)

All — summarizing the agreement and next steps so we have a single source of truth prior to the go/no-go sync on Wed 5/26 (note: moving the sync earlier to accommodate calendars):

1) Timeline & commitments
- Redwood to publish final term sheet + SOW by EOD 5/26 (Ben).
- Orbital to return redlines by EOD 5/27 if any; if no redlines, Redwood to send DocuSign 5/27.
- Target signature window: 5 business days (5/27–6/2). If signatures are completed by 6/24 we can commit to 2027-07-01 start; if signatures complete by 6/30 start moves to 2027-07-05.

2) Approvals & owner list (final)
- Commercial approval: Hannah Riley (Orbital)
- Procurement routing & legal approval: Markus Weber + LegalOps (Orbital)
- Redwood legal: Ben Carter (owner for term sheet/SOW)
- Onboarding owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood)

3) Final gating items before DocuSign
- SOC2 Type II link + retention summary confirmed by Redwood security (Irene)
- Signed NDA already in place (confirmed)
- Pre-kick checklist: sample data access, integration contacts, and kickoff availability (Marissa to collect from Orbital)

4) Contingency play
- If legal requests material contract language that delays the signature beyond our windows, we’ll offer a two-week sandbox (limited scope) to preserve alignment and prevent resource booking conflicts.

5) Action owners & deadlines (short):
- Ben: final term sheet + SOW (EOD 5/26) — will send redline PDF if any changes after 5/27.
- Irene (security): SOC2 link + retention summary by 5/26 — cc to Markus.
- Marissa: pre-kick checklist and resource hold confirmation by 5/28.
- Marcus/Karthik: schedule final go/no-go sync (moved to 5/26 08:00 PT) and send calendar invite.

Hannah/Markus — once Ben publishes the final docs, please confirm an internal approver list for signature routing so we can set DocuSign ordering. If you’re good with the plan below, I’ll lock the sync and Ben will circulate the docs.
